propositions: A new built-in plan-review criterion T15 'overlay-derisk' must be created with agentic execution mode, routing via LLM content analysis, and applicability gated by S1-S3 conditions (codified loop, slow/costly pass, runtime-only correctness).

The T15 rubric must evaluate four checks: (a) risk mechanism named, (b) fast out-of-loop proof committed, (c) proof-before-codify sequencing, (d) scoped cleanup with no pre-existing resource deletion.
Routing entry T15 must specify exec='AGENT', facet='overlay-derisk', overlay_routing='llm', and applies_at suppress_types=['bug'], with posture inherited from registry default.

The criterion artifact, routing entry, and registry must be created and the criteria guide must be regenerated, with all five acceptance criteria validators passing and 'rebar explain T15' displaying the criterion name and full rubric.

The S1-S3 applicability gates and checks a-d plus ANTI-FP paragraph must be authored verbatim in the rubric with front-matter field execution_mode set to the loader enum value 'agentic' (not the routing exec value 'AGENT').
